introduce:
Lie flat on the floor, and lift your hips off the floor while keeping your back straight. 

Hold this position as long as you can. Breathe normally. Don't hold your breath.

The bridge exercise strengthens the whole abdomen, the lower back and the glutes.
name: BRIDGE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Tighten your abdominal muscles.
Breathe naturally.
Lift your one leg up if it's too easy for you.
This is a great exercise to target your legs, core and gluteus.

introduce:
Start with your knees and hands on the floor. Put your hands a little forward, widen your knees and put your toes together. 

Take a breath, then exhale and sit back. Try to make your butt touch your heels. Relax your elbows, make your forehead touch the floor and try to lower your chest close to the floor. Hold this position.

Keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back. Make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears during the exercise.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Lie down on your back with your legs extended.\n\nBend your knees and bring them up toward your chest; hug your knees with both hands. Breathe naturally. Hold for a few seconds.
name: DOUBLE KNEES TO CHEST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Hold on your thighs instead if you have knee injuries.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your lower back muscles.
It helps to restore flexibility to your lower back.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder-width apart. Raise your arms at your sides to shoulder height with your palms down.

Turn your left foot to the left and your right foot 45 degrees to the left. Slightly shift your hips to the right, and bend your torso to the left until your left hand is pressed on the floor. 

Extend your right arm toward the ceiling, and turn your head to look at your right hand. Breathe slowly and deeply. Hold this position.
name: TRIANGLE POSE LEFT

tips.text: Please keep your chest facing forward.
Please keep your arms and legs straight during the exercise.
If you feel it\'s too hard, put your left hand on your left leg instead of the floor.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder-width apart. Raise your arms at your sides to shoulder height with your palms down. 

Turn your right foot to the right and your left foot 45 degrees to the right. Slightly shift your hips to the left, and bend your torso to the right until your right hand is pressed on the floor. 

Extend your left arm toward the ceiling, and turn your head to look at your left hand. Breathe slowly and deeply. Hold this position.
name: TRIANGLE POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Please keep your chest facing forward.
Please keep your arms and legs straight during the exercise.
If you feel it\'s too hard, put your right hand on your right leg instead of the floor.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Kneeling on the ground with knees hip-width apart. Open your chest, squeeze your inner thigh, and slowly lean your upper body back. 

Exhale, draw your shoulder blades down and press your hands on your heels. Inhale, drop your head and slightly push your hips forward. 

Breathe slowly and deeply. Hold this position.
name: CAMEL

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your belly engaged.
Breathe naturally.
This pose stretches your chest and abdomen.
This pose can improve your spinal flexibility.

introduce:
Start with your legs wide apart. Fold your upper body forward. 

Try to press your hands to the floor as much as possible. Release and repeat.

Exhale when you press your hands down, and inhale when you release. This exercise stretches the back of your legs.
name: WIDE LEG HAMSTRING STRETCH

tips.text: Try to press your hands to the floor as much as possible.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your legs straight.
Exhale when you press your hands down, and inhale when you release.
This exercise stretches the back of your legs.

introduce: Lie on your stomach with your legs extended and your arms by your sides. \n\nLift your shoulders, legs, and arms off the floor with your palms toward the ceiling. Breathe normally. Hold this position.
name: LOCUST POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your pelvis on the floor when lifting your legs.
Breathe naturally.
This exercise tones your buttocks and strengthens your back muscles.

introduce:
Stand with your feet hip-width apart. Draw your belly in and tuck your tailbone down. Roll your shoulders back and down. 

Bend your upper body forward and rest your hands on your legs. Bend from your hips instead of your waist. 

Breathe naturally. Focus on keeping your back flat and lengthening your spine. Hold this position.
name: HALF FORWARD BEND

tips.text: Bend from your hips instead of your waist.
Keep your legs straight but don\'t lock your knees.
Focus on keeping your back flat and lengthening your spine.
Breathe naturally.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings.
This exercise strengthens your back.

introduce:
Stand upright with your arms by your sides. Interlock your fingers and turn your palms upwards. 

Inhale, stretch your arms to the ceiling while simultaneously raising your heels. Your balance will shift to your toes. 

Hold for seconds. Return and repeat.
name: PALM TREE POSE

tips.text: Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your back straight.
This exercise stretches your entire body and improves your balance.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Start on all fours with your hips up in an upside-down \'V\' shape. Alternately lift and lower your heels.\n\nBreathe regularly throughout the pose.
name: WALK THE DOG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Relax your neck.
Breathe regularly.
Notice the elongation from your fingertips to your sit bone.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Please press all areas of the palms equally on the floor.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, hamstrings, calves, and arches.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your arms close to your body. 

As you exhale, press your elbows and forearms into the floor to lift your upper back off the floor. 

Rest the crown of your head on the floor. Hold this position.
name: FISH POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Too much pressure on your head or neck? You can put a little more weight on your arms.
This exercise helps ease tensions in your spine and neck.
This exercise opens your chest and strengthens your back and shoulders.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart. 

Turn your left foot to the left and your right foot 60 degrees to the left.

Bend your left leg until your thigh is almost parallel to the floor. 

As you exhale, bend your upper body to the left and rest your left elbow on your left knee.

Extend your right arm by your ear to the left. Take full and deep breaths. Hold this position.
name: EXTENDED SIDE ANGLE LEFT

tips.text: Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Don\'t let your knee go over your toes.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.
Put your weight mainly on your legs instead of your elbow.
This exercise strengthens your shoulders, thighs, and glutes.
This exercise stretches your groins, hamstrings, waist, and shoulders.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart. 

Turn your right foot to the right and your left foot 60 degrees to the right.

Bend your right leg until your thigh is almost parallel to the floor. 

As you exhale, bend your upper body to the right and rest your right elbow on your right knee.

Extend your left arm by your ear to the right. Take full and deep breaths. Hold this position.
name: EXTENDED SIDE ANGLE RIGHT

tips.text: Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Don't let your knee go over your toes.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.
Put your weight mainly on your legs instead of your elbow.
This exercise strengthens your shoulders, thighs, and glutes.
This exercise stretches your groins, hamstrings, waist, and shoulders.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart. 

Fold your body forward. Interlace your fingers behind you and straighten your arms. 

Bring your arms forward. Hold this position.
name: STANDING FORWARD BEND WITH SHOULDER OPENER

tips.text: Breathe naturally.
Keep your neck relaxed.
This exercise helps increase the mobility of your shoulders.

introduce:
Sit on the mat. Bend your knees and stack your left knee over your right. 

Raise your left arm overhead. Bend your left elbow and place your left hand between your shoulder blades. Make sure your left elbow is pointing toward the ceiling. 

Bend your right elbow and reach your hands toward each other until they touch. Clasp your hands or fingers if possible. Hold this position.
name: COW FACE LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
If your hands can't touch each other, you can grab a towel.
Breathe naturally.
Don't twist your spine.
Don't lean your head and body to the side.
Keep your spine straight.

introduce:
Sit on the mat. Bend your knees and stack your right knee over your left. 

Raise your right arm overhead. Bend your right elbow and place your right hand between your shoulder blades. Make sure your right elbow is pointing toward the ceiling. 

Bend your left elbow and reach your hands toward each other until they touch. Clasp your hands or fingers if possible. Hold this position.
name: COW FACE RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
If your hands can't touch each other, you can grab a towel.
Breathe naturally.
Don't twist your spine.
Don't lean your head and body to the side.
Keep your spine straight.

introduce:
Sit on your heels with your knees hip-width apart. Raise your arms over your head. 

Lower your arms on the floor and extend them forward as far as possible. 

Lift your hips and slide your body forward until your hips are directly above your knees. 

Release your forehead on the mat. Lower your chest to stretch your shoulders. Hold this position.
name: PUPPY DOG POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Breathe naturally.
Keep your hips directly above your knees.
This exercise helps stretch your upper body and tight shoulders.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs straight. Extend your left arm to your side. Rotate your body to the right. 

Place your right foot behind your left leg to support you. 

Slightly lift your head to keep your neck in line with your spine. Hold this position.
name: OPEN WING POSE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.
Take deep breaths.
This pose helps relieve stress and tension throughout your shoulders.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs straight. Extend your right arm to your side. Rotate your body to the left. 

Place your left foot behind your right leg to support you. 

Slightly lift your head to keep your neck in line with your spine. Hold this position.
name: OPEN WING POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.
Take deep breaths.
This pose helps relieve stress and tension throughout your shoulders.

introduce:
Sit up straight on the mat with your legs straight ahead. 

Bend and widen your knees and cross your legs at the shins. 

Place your hands on your knees, palms down.
name: EASY POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Breathe in deeply and slowly breathe out.
This pose will help you to calm and relax.
